question: How should the limbs of the mātṛkā be ritually fashioned?
premises: Letters located at heart and other places are used.
The mātṛkā limbs are the object.
inference: One should fashion the limbs of the mātṛkā with the letters located at the heart and other places.
plain_english: One should fashion the limbs of the mātṛkā with the letters located at the heart and other places.
